existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For duplicated copies of records not larger than 14 by 8.5 inches, the agency may charge up to 15 cents per one-sided copy.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency provides a standard-size one-sided duplicated copy
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Up to 15 cents per one-sided copy for duplicated copies of not more than 14 inches by 8 1/2 inches.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. Basis is a ceiling ('up to 15 cents') — city sets the operative rate at or below $0.15/page.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For a two-sided copy, the agency may charge no more than an additional 5 cents.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency provides a two-sided duplicated copy
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: No more than an additional 5 cents for each two-sided copy.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. Ceiling of an additional $0.05 per two-sided copy.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Actual cost of duplication for other copies
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For all copies other than standard-size paper copies, the agency charges the actual cost of duplication of the public record.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency provides a copy that is not a standard-size paper copy
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: For all other copies, the actual cost of duplication of the public record.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. 'Actual cost of duplication' is bounded by the statutory definition in FL-0023.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: 'Actual cost of duplication' means the cost of the material and supplies used to duplicate the record, and does not include labor cost or overhead cost associated with such duplication.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Charging 'actual cost of duplication' under s. 119.07(4)(a)3.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: "Actual cost of duplication" means the cost of the material and supplies used to duplicate the public record, but does not include labor cost or overhead cost associated with such duplication.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. Definition the fee engine branches on — labor/overhead are excluded from the base copy charge (they belong only to the special service charge, FL-0025).

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: An agency may charge up to $1 per copy for a certified copy of a public record.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester asks for a certified copy
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: An agency may charge up to $1 per copy for a certified copy of a public record.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. Ceiling of $1.00 per certified copy.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Special service charge for extensive IT or clerical/supervisory assistance
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: If the nature or volume of records requires extensive use of IT resources or extensive clerical/supervisory assistance, the agency may charge, in addition to actual duplication cost, a reasonable special service charge based on the cost actually incurred.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Nature or volume of records requires extensive use of IT resources or extensive clerical/supervisory assistance (or both)
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If the nature or volume of public records requested to be inspected or copied pursuant to this subsection is such as to require extensive use of information technology resources or extensive clerical or supervisory assistance by personnel of the agency involved, or both, the agency may charge, in addition to the actual cost of duplication, a special service charge, which shall be reasonable and shall be based on the cost incurred for such extensive use of information technology resources or the labor cost of the personnel providing the service that is actually incurred by the agency or attributable to the agency for the clerical and supervisory assistance required, or both.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. 'Reasonable' with no fixed number = soft-standard; city sets a rate methodology under the reasonableness constraint. Applies to inspection as well as copying. Trigger term 'extensive' is undefined.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Supervision charge when requester photographs records
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: When a person photographs public records, the custodian may charge for supervision services at a rate agreed upon by the parties; if they cannot agree, the custodian determines the charge.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: A person elects to photograph public records rather than obtain agency copies
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The custodian of public records may charge the person making the photographs for supervision services at a rate of compensation to be agreed upon by the person desiring to make the photographs and the custodian of public records. If they fail to agree as to the appropriate charge, the charge shall be determined by the custodian of public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. No fixed number — negotiated/custodian-set = soft-standard.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Requester pays expense of a separate room/place to photograph records
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Where another room or place is necessary to photograph public records, the expense of providing it is paid by the person desiring to photograph the records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Photographing records requires provision of another room or place
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Where provision of another room or place is necessary to photograph public records, the expense of providing the same shall be paid by the person desiring to photograph the public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. Charge equals the actual expense incurred (fixed to cost).
